The stock of TransDigm Group Incorporated (TDG) formed an up wedge with $385.38 target or 9.00 % above today’s $353.56 share price. The 8 months wedge indicates low risk for the $18.65B company. If the $385.38 price target is reached, the company will be worth $1.68B more. Rising wedges, especially for downward breakouts are tricky moments to trade. Investors must be aware that the break even failure rate for up or down breakouts is: 8% and 24%. The average rise is 28% and the decline is 14%. Wedges has high throwback and pullback rate: 73%, 63% and the percent of wedges meeting target is not more than 50%.
